sources.aliases_note: Only orthographic variants and explicit components of compound official names. Component selection refers to the entire displayed municipal district; no component boundary is invented.

limitations: Successfully retrieved the current public GIS MapServer metadata: 52 layers, none a neighborhood boundary layer. All seven geometries remain null with explicitly approximate general-area reference markers; no school-registration or other unrelated boundary substitutes are used.
The map and registry divide the city into seven current municipal communication areas; southern historical and local sub-neighborhood names are not invented as separate polygon choices.
IDs 14-20 are official municipal resident-neighborhood subscription subject IDs, not GIS polygon IDs.
Source raster was published in 2021 and remains on the current municipal page; retrieval in 2026 is not a claim of a 2026 boundary update.
Reference points are public places on officially assigned streets; they do not represent precise boundaries or guaranteed geometric centers.

Official neighborhood-number field no is non-unique: מרכז העיר and רמת צדק both have0. Source OBJECTID is used for every ID; municipal_neighborhood_no is retained separately. Preserve canonical IDs and explicitly reconcile any future source republish/reorder.
